newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-SUPER BOWL MOST VALUABLE PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-SUPER BOWL MOST VALUABLE PLAYERS.

text.p: Most Valuable Player award
winners from the past 30 Super Bowls (tabulate under Super
Bowl number, year played, MVP, player's position, team):
30. 1996 - Larry Brown, defensive back, Dallas Cowboys
29. 1995 - Steve Young, quarterback, San Francisco 49ers
28. 1994 - Emmitt Smith, running back, Dallas Cowboys
27. 1993 - Troy Aikman, quarterback, Dallas Cowboys
26. 1992 - Mark Rypien, quarterback, Washington Redskins
25. 1991 - Ottis Anderson, running back, New York Giants
24. 1990 - Joe Montana, quarterback, San Francisco 49ers
23. 1989 - Jerry Rice, wide receiver, San Francisco 49ers
22. 1988 - Doug Williams, quarterback, Washington Redskins
21. 1987 - Phil Simms, quarterback, New York Giants
20. 1986 - Richard Dent, defensive end, Chicago Bears
19. 1985 - Joe Montana, quarterback, San Francisco 49ers
18. 1984 - Marcus Allen, running back, Los Angeles Raiders
17. 1983 - John Riggins, running back, Washington Redskins
16. 1982 - Joe Montana, quarterback, San Francisco 49ers
15. 1981 - Jim Plunkett, quarterback, Oakland Raiders
14. 1980 - Terry Bradshaw, quarterback, Pittsburgh Steelers
13. 1979 - Terry Bradshaw, quarterback, Pittsburgh Steelers
12. 1978 - Randy White, defensive lineman, and Harvey Martin,
defensive lineman, Dallas Cowboys
11. 1977 - Fred Biletnikoff, wide receiver, Oakland Raiders
10. 1976 - Lynn Swann, wide receiver, Pittsburgh Steelers
9. 1975 - Franco Harris, running back, Pittsburgh Steelers
8. 1974 - Larry Csonka, running back, Miami Dolphins
7. 1973 - Jake Scott, defensive back, Miami Dolphins
6. 1972 - Roger Staubach, quarterback, Dallas Cowboys
5. 1971 - Chuck Howley, linebacker, Dallas Cowboys
4. 1970 - Len Dawson, quarterback, Kansas City Chiefs
3. 1969 - Joe Namath, quarterback, New York Jets
2. 1968 - Bart Starr, quarterback, Green Bay Packers
1. 1967 - Bart Starr, quarterback, Green Bay Packers
